faq.title: Before you start, this might interest you
faq.subtitle: We answer the most common questions so you have full clarity before working with us.

items.question: What are Pointers' main services?
items.answer: Branding & Visual Identity, Web Design & Digital Experience, Content & Social Presence, and Digital Strategy & Advertising. We combine strategy, design and technology to build solutions that truly work.

items.question: What if I don't have a defined brand yet?
items.answer: In the Discovery phase we analyze your business, competitors and opportunities to define a solid starting point. Then, in Strategy & Concept, we outline the plan and project identity.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a project?
items.answer: Timing depends on scope: branding, web, content or campaigns. After Discovery we define a clear timeline in the Strategy & Concept stage.

items.question: Can I request changes during the project?
items.answer: Yes. Our workflow is modern and collaborative: in Design & Development we turn strategy into visual and functional experiences, with room for revisions before Optimization & Growth.

items.question: How can I start working with you?
items.answer: Tell us about your project and let's take the next step together. Reach out via the contact form or tap Let's talk! in any section.
